description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). PLACE one crypto board vehicle with the signed-in user's OWN money through the routed plan: it fills on its best venue (DEX via their own trading wallet, the order book from their balance, or their own exchange). A vehicle no venue of theirs can settle is said so — nothing is forced and nothing is paid from platform funds. Call after theme_journey_route_vehicle and confirm_action. (needs your linked account's key)

conversation_id.description: conversation_id returned by an earlier theme_journey_* call (keeps an anonymous visitor's interests and basket together until they register).

usdc_amount.description: ticket size in USD from the user's own balance (their USDT spends 1:1)
